observations.body: Servants and women are tested for trustworthy service. Servants, in the same way, must be reverent, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for money, For those who have served well gain for themselves a good standing and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.

payload.posture: Read 1 Timothy 3:8–13 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states servants and women are tested for trustworthy service. Servants, in the same way, must be reverent, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for money, For those who have served well gain for themselves a good standing and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
